items.name: Default
items.summary: Standard progress bar for representing completion levels from 0% to 100% for task tracking.

items.name: Status
items.summary: Progress bars with different status colors showing completion levels from 0% to 100% for task tracking.

items.name: Max
items.summary: Progress bars with custom max values for representing non-percentage based progress like file counts or steps.

items.name: Labeled
items.template:
Upload Status

80%
items.summary: Use a labeled progress bar with percentage display to communicate upload or task status.

items.name: Indeterminate
items.summary: Indeterminate progress bar for showing activity when completion time is unknown, like loading or processing.

items.name: IndeterminateStatusColors
items.summary: Progress bars display as an animated loading indicator when no `value` attribute exists.

items.name: IndeterminateCustomColor
items.summary: Indeterminate progress bar with custom color, height, and opacity for brand-specific styling and visual emphasis.

items.name: CustomHeights
items.summary: Progress bars with custom heights for different visual prominence levels and layout requirements.
items.description: The progress bar's height accepts customization through the `--height` CSS custom property. This allows you to create progress bars that match your application's visual hierarchy and emphasis needs. For consistency and theming, use design system tokens, but any value that suits your layout also works.
